description_en: Queries the compliance summary from the perspective of rule compliance evaluation results
description_zh: 从规则的合规评估结果维度查询合规概要
name: GetResourceComplianceByConfigRule

parameters.help_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:
COMPLIANT: Compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: Non-compliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: Not applicable.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No data
parameters.help_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据
parameters.name: compliance_type

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID.

For information about how to obtain a rule ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.help_zh:
